title: Dissertation Dry Run
summary: Finale: the Crew Log as a complete Quarto report: setup, one row per person, participants, an APA table and figure, two research questions written up with inline R, and nothing typed by hand.

steps.title: Setup
steps.summary: A title and author in the YAML header; a hidden setup chunk that loads the packages and reads the log into `crew`.

steps.title: Cases
steps.summary: `people`: one row per astronaut (their first mission) with `sex`, `age` at first flight and `total_missions`.

steps.title: Participants
steps.summary: A sentence with the number of astronauts and of women, both written by inline R.

steps.title: Table
steps.summary: `age_by_sex` (n, M, SD of age by sex) as an APA table captioned Age at First Flight by Sex, code hidden.

steps.title: Figure
steps.summary: `age_plot`: age at first flight by sex, drawn in the report with readable axis labels.

steps.title: RQ1
steps.summary: Welch's t-test of age by sex in `age_test`, d in `age_d`, reported in APA style with inline R.

steps.title: RQ2
steps.summary: Spearman's correlation of age with total missions in `missions_cor`, reported in APA style with inline R.

steps.title: Reproducible
steps.summary: No statistic typed into the text: every number comes from R.

hints: Setup: put `#| include: false` in the setup chunk. `knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)` there hides the code of every later chunk.
Cases: `people <- crew |> filter(mission_number == 1) |> transmute(number, sex, age = year_of_mission - year_of_birth, total_missions = total_number_of_missions)`.
Participants: `` `r nrow(people)` `` astronauts, `` `r sum(people$sex == "female")` `` of them women.

RQ1: `age_test <- t.test(age ~ sex, data = people)`, `age_d <- cohens_d(age ~ sex, data = people)$Cohens_d`; in the text: `` *t*(`r fmt_num(age_test$parameter)`) = `r fmt_num(age_test$statistic)`, *p* `r fmt_p(age_test$p.value)`, *d* = `r fmt_num(age_d)` ``.
RQ2: `cor.test(people$age, people$total_missions, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)`; in the text: `` *r*~s~ = `r fmt_bounded(missions_cor$estimate)`, *p* `r fmt_p(missions_cor$p.value)` ``.
